guides.title: A simple three-step morning routine
guides.summary: Start with gentle cleansing, moisturizer, and sun protection.

guides.title: A minimal evening routine
guides.summary: Begin by removing the day’s residue and adding comfortable moisture.

guides.title: Add one new product at a time
guides.summary: Introduce one product at a time so changes in comfort are easier to identify.

guides.title: How to simplify an overcrowded routine
guides.summary: Keep the basic steps and remove optional products that serve the same role.

guides.title: Toner, essence, and cream order
guides.summary: After cleansing, move from lighter to richer textures without treating every step as mandatory.

guides.title: Why morning and evening routines differ
guides.summary: Morning focuses on daytime protection; evening focuses on cleansing and moisture.

guides.title: Reduce pilling before makeup
guides.summary: Use fewer products, smaller amounts, and let each layer settle before the next.

guides.title: Choose one product among similar textures
guides.summary: Compare purpose and feel, then choose one product for the same role.

guides.title: How to use toner
guides.summary: Use a thin optional layer after cleansing and avoid unnecessary rubbing.

guides.title: How to use skincare pads
guides.summary: Follow the labeled purpose and contact time, and avoid repeated hard wiping.

guides.title: How to use ampoules and serums
guides.summary: Start with one product for the same purpose and use it as an optional step before moisturizer.

guides.title: How to use emulsion
guides.summary: Use it as a light moisturizer and choose one product when moisturizing roles overlap.

guides.title: How to use cream and balm
guides.summary: Use one as a finishing moisture step according to dryness and comfort.

guides.title: How to use a face mask
guides.summary: Follow the labeled time and do not use a mask as a replacement for basic care.

guides.title: Single and double cleansing
guides.summary: Clean only as much as needed for makeup and residue; double cleansing is not mandatory for everyone.

guides.title: How to use sunscreen and sunscreen sticks
guides.summary: Apply evenly as the final daytime skincare step and reapply according to the label.

guides.title: A routine for hot, humid weather
guides.summary: Keep light moisture and sun protection while reducing heavy optional layers.

guides.title: A routine for cold, dry weather
guides.summary: Use gentle cleansing and moisturizer while reducing frequent exfoliation.

guides.title: A post-workout routine
guides.summary: Gently remove sweat and residue, then return to moisture and daytime sun protection.

guides.title: A minimal travel routine
guides.summary: Pack familiar cleansing, moisturizing, and sun-protection basics.

guides.title: Avoid excessive layering
guides.summary: More products are not always better; remove optional steps that serve the same purpose.

guides.title: Avoid frequent exfoliation
guides.summary: Follow labeled frequency and comfort signals instead of scrubbing more often or harder.

guides.title: Do not ignore stinging
guides.summary: Do not treat stinging or burning as proof that a product is working; stop using it.

guides.title: Separate advertising from directions
guides.summary: Prioritize the product label and verifiable sources over dramatic claims or before-and-after images.
